extracted_definitions.definition: Score 0, 1+, 2+, or 3+ based on membrane staining
extracted_definitions.source_excerpt: Only a complete and crisp membrane staining without any cytoplasmic staining in >30% of cells should be interpreted as score 3 or positive. Score 2 staining results in complete membrane staining but in <30% of cells and considered equivocal. All other staining is negative (score1/0).
extracted_definitions.scope_rationale: HER2neu IHC score is a standardized definition that applies beyond this specialty.

item.action_hint: Use FDA-approved Hercep test or Ventana Her2neu assay, or validate non-validated antibody with FISH or FDA-approved IHC assays
item.source_excerpt: Her2neu IHC testing should ideally be done by the FDA approved Hercep test OR Ventana Her2neu assay. However these FDA approved assays are not commonly used in India due to their cost. Hence before using any non validated antibody in routine practice, the laboratory should validate it either with FISH or the FDA approved IHC assays.
item.scope_rationale: This rule is specific to the pathology specialty and the testing of HER2neu IHC.
